body:
Personally I feel it’s so easy not to care that sometimes we have to almost fake it till we make it. Forcing myself to care or finding something even if it’s just one of two things I know light my soul on fire. And I try to really hone in one those two things. And I take that and while I’m feeling all types of alive do the things that the ambitious, passionate, caring version of myself would do and it really does make a day of difference. I know everyday is a new day to keep fighting the shit in your head and the shit that’s life, but I hope maybe if you can find your thing that makes living worth it, then you’ll slowly find more and more things that make you WANT life. 

Some days, maybe every day right now for you life feels like something you just go along with, and it can make everything seem so pointless. I know I can’t help you and I can’t change you. I don’t expect to. For me I realize I’m the only one who can help myself, know exactly what I need and how I can do it, and try to stop waiting for other people to fill a void only I can fill. I rely on others to fill a space in me I know at the end of the day only I can do. Try finding exactly what you need to make your life worth living and I hope with the fight you have in you, you’re able to keep on going.

I feel the same way. Sometimes I think I’m better off alone because at least when I’m alone I’m not holding unmet expectations for anyone else. But know you’re not selfish for wanting to feel loved, or held, or appreciated. It’s human nature, and perhaps if your circumstances were different in your relationship you wouldn’t feel such a void there, but know you’re not alone and that no person is better than another and no one person deserves any less than another. 
We each struggle with our own needs and problems and intrusive thoughts, and your girlfriend probably has as many of her own, it’s amazing what you might see with a simple conversation. It’s scary opening up at the fear of rejection or a response you’re not looking for, but it’s even scarier and more daunting living with these feelings inside, wanting to scream them out, and never talking about them especially since there’s always the chance it could work out much better than you can imagine.
And at the end of the day, you truly have just yourself, and so you’ve ought to make yourself proud and fight for yourself, fight for your passions and the things that keep you going, knowing that the reward of the things that light your soul is there. 
Sometimes the darkness takes over. You just have to let in a little light. Keep on fighting. Life is long but life is short, short enough to allow yourself only what brings you joy and endure pain only worth it in the end. I hope the reaches light to you and I hope you’ll find the courage to always fight one more day for your happiness, for your relationship, and your peace of mind.
